Text styles

display: The page's one display heading .

h1: Page heading. Every heading is set in Plex Regular ; size carries the hierarchy.

h2: Section heading.

h3: Card and group heading.

h4: Minor heading, dialog and panel title.

lead: The paragraph that opens a page or section, in the secondary text colour.

body: Running text and controls' text.

label: Hints, metadata, chips and compact controls.

kicker: Upper-case label over a heading or a field ; never the only cue.

caption: Captions, legal lines and footnotes.

code: Commands, keys and code, slightly smaller than the text around it.

Components

App bar implemented

The top of a product: brand, navigation and settings; sticky without covering focus.

NDDev
  • Workspace
  • Library
Project
Pattern
APG landmarks · <header> banner
Anatomy
  • brand: The mark and the wordmark, a link home.
  • navigation (optional): Primary destinations.
  • actions (optional): Theme, language, motion settings.
Variants
site, app
States
default, scrolled
Keyboard
  • Tab: Through its controls.
Accessibility
banner
  • A sticky bar sets scroll-padding so a focused element is never hidden under it (2.4.11).
  • Sticky positioning is opt-in; the product sets --sticky-offset to the actual bar height, including reflow.
WCAG 2.2
1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A); 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (A); 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) (AA); 1.4.10 Reflow (AA)
Platforms
  • web: header.nd-app-bar
  • ios: toolbar / navigationTitle
  • android: TopAppBar
  • flutter: AppBar

Button implemented

Starts an action or, as a button-link, goes to a page that continues the task.

Button link
Pattern
APG button · <button type="button"> or <a> for navigation
Anatomy
  • container: The target: at least the minimum target size, padding from the size.
  • label: A verb or a destination; never only an icon unless it has an accessible name.
  • icon (optional): Leading or trailing; the forward arrow turns with the reading direction.
Variants
primary, secondary, quiet · sizes md, lg
States
default, hover, active, focus-visible (The global ring: 2 px outline, 2 px gap, focus.ring colour.), disabled (Dashed hollow outline and tertiary text; not colour alone.), pending (Keeps its label, adds a turning mark (dotted and still under reduced motion) and aria-busy; a status region announces the outcome.)
Keyboard
  • Enter, Space: Activates the button.
  • Enter: Follows a button-link.
Accessibility
button (link for a button-link) · name: Its text; an icon-only button has aria-label.
  • Prefer aria-disabled with an explanation over removing a control from the tab order.
  • A destructive action names what it destroys.
WCAG 2.2
1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA); 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA); 2.1.1 Keyboard (A); 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA); 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA); 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) (AA); 2.5.3 Label in Name (A); 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA); 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)
Platforms
  • web: button.nd-button / a.nd-button
  • ios: Button with a ButtonStyle drawing button.* colours
  • android: Button, OutlinedButton, TextButton (Material 3 mapped by NDDevTheme)
  • flutter: FilledButton, OutlinedButton, TextButton

Menu implemented

A popup list of actions or choices opened by a button.

Comfortable
Compact
Custom (unavailable)

Pattern
APG menu-button · <button aria-haspopup> with role=menu, or a popover listbox
Anatomy
  • button: Opens the menu; aria-expanded.
  • surface: Overlay, elevation 2.
  • item: An action or a choice; a chosen one has a check.
Variants
actions, choice
States
closed, open, item-hover, item-focus, item-selected (A check mark.), item-disabled
Keyboard
  • Enter, Space, Down: Open; actions focus the first item, choices focus the selected option when available.
  • Up, Down: Move.
  • Escape: Close and return to the button.
  • Home, End: First, last item.
  • Tab, Shift+Tab: Close and continue through the page.
  • Letters: Type-ahead to a matching item; repeated letters cycle.
Accessibility
menu / menuitem, or listbox / option · name: The button's label.
  • A menu of links is a disclosure with links, not role=menu.
  • Disabled items stay discoverable with aria-disabled but cannot be activated.
  • The runnable reference demonstrates focus, type-ahead, selection, dismissal and viewport placement; the product owns actions and persistence.
  • Placement: CSS anchor positioning holds the menu below its trigger at the start edge and flips it when space runs out (anchor-name on the trigger, position-anchor on the menu); a script places it where the engine lacks anchor positioning.
WCAG 2.2
